voiceover.hook: Six Pokémon, one run. Can this Kanto team beat the Elite Four?
voiceover.outro: Which Pokémon would you swap out? Tell me in the comments below.

line.text: For Agatha, we need an answer, and Nidoqueen is it. Earthquake wipes out Haunter in a single hit. Hyper Beam comes from TM15.
Lance looks scary, but Raichu makes it easy. Thunderbolt knocks out Gyarados in one hit. It spreads paralysis, so slower enemies can barely move.
Against Blaine, we bring in Gyarados. Hydro Pump knocks out Growlithe in one hit, and that decides the fight. Surf comes from HM3.
Against Lorelei, we bring in Parasect. Solar Beam knocks out Cloyster in one hit, and that decides the fight. Dig comes from TM28.
Here's a pick we can count on: Machamp. You can find it in Rock Tunnel B1F. Then Dig gives it real power from TM28.
Our next pick is Snorlax. It's yours at Route 12, and once it has Hyper Beam at level 56, it hits hard.
